qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit.intent: Auto-continue for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit.intentEn: Auto-continue for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit.intentZh: dsh 网页端输出上限自动继续：本地模型输出到上限出现提示时，自动发送「继续」让回复接上；双源截断检测、防死循环保护，完全无 UI。

qwert702/dsh-context-compressor.intent: One-click context compression for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
qwert702/dsh-context-compressor.intentEn: One-click context compression for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
qwert702/dsh-context-compressor.intentZh: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

qwert702/dsh-auto-translate.intent: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: live translation of model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
qwert702/dsh-auto-translate.intentEn: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: live translation of model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
qwert702/dsh-auto-translate.intentZh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

tmpdot/dsh-checkpoint-diff.intent: Checkpoint timeline diff & rollback for DeepSeek Harness — turn dsh-checkpoint-rewind checkpoints into a browsable timeline (session/project scope) with line-level file diffs between any two nodes, trace replay from session logs, and preview-style rollback (node/file, dry-run, in-process undo).
tmpdot/dsh-checkpoint-diff.intentEn: Checkpoint timeline diff & rollback for DeepSeek Harness — turn dsh-checkpoint-rewind checkpoints into a browsable timeline (session/project scope) with line-level file diffs between any two nodes, trace replay from session logs, and preview-style rollback (node/file, dry-run, in-process undo).
tmpdot/dsh-checkpoint-diff.intentZh: DeepSeek Harness 检查点时间线 diff 与回滚——把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 的检查点变成可浏览时间线（会话/项目范围），任意两节点间逐文件行级 diff，从会话日志重放 trace，并提供预览式回滚（整节点/单文件、dry-run、进程内一次性撤销）。

Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything.intent: Reference Anything in DeepSeek Harness — extend the unified @ menu to cite workspace files, DSH sessions, and chat histories from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi.
Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything.intentEn: Reference Anything in DeepSeek Harness — extend the unified @ menu to cite workspace files, DSH sessions, and chat histories from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi.
Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything.intentZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中「引用一切」——扩展统一的 @ 菜单，可引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok、Kimi 的历史对话。

scwlkq/deepseek-harness.intent: Task Board plugin (bundled in a DeepSeek Harness build): a five-state kanban (init/in-progress/review/done/failed) with CRUD, search, drag-reorder, agent start/stop/approve/retry/reopen, round summaries, session jump, and Storage Domain persistence.
scwlkq/deepseek-harness.intentEn: Task Board plugin (bundled in a DeepSeek Harness build): a five-state kanban (init/in-progress/review/done/failed) with CRUD, search, drag-reorder, agent start/stop/approve/retry/reopen, round summaries, session jump, and Storage Domain persistence.
scwlkq/deepseek-harness.intentZh: 任务看板插件（随 DeepSeek Harness 构建发布）：五态看板（初始化/执行中/待审核/已完成/失败），支持增删改查、搜索、同列拖拽排序，Agent 启动/停止/通过/驳回/重试/重开，轮次摘要、会话跳转与 Storage Domain 持久化。

ravenli059/dsh-login.intent: Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: requires username and password authentication before accessing the interface when the dsh-web port is opened.
ravenli059/dsh-login.intentEn: Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: requires username and password authentication before accessing the interface when the dsh-web port is opened.
ravenli059/dsh-login.intentZh: 给 dsh-web 加一道登录门：打开 dsh-web 的端口时先要输入用户名和密码，验证通过后才能看到界面。

ravenli059/dsh-android-agent.intent: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: connects to Android phones via WebSocket for remote operations and automated testing.
ravenli059/dsh-android-agent.intentEn: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: connects to Android phones via WebSocket for remote operations and automated testing.
ravenli059/dsh-android-agent.intentZh: dsh-web 插件，支持用 websocket 方式连接到安卓手机，执行远程操作和自动测试。

qwert702/dsh-commander.intent: Commander mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
qwert702/dsh-commander.intentEn: Commander mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
qwert702/dsh-commander.intentZh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

qwert702/dsh-memory.intent: Project+global long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: split POST /items endpoints to avoid path conflicts, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.
qwert702/dsh-memory.intentEn: Project+global long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: split POST /items endpoints to avoid path conflicts, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.
qwert702/dsh-memory.intentZh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

maxwell-feng/dsh-searxng-web.intent: DeepSeek Harness plugin that backs the native web_search / web_fetch tools with your own self-hosted SearXNG instance — keyless, private, no third-party search vendor; rides dsh's ctx.web provider seam so every agent and subagent inherits it, with an SSRF-guarded fetch provider included.
maxwell-feng/dsh-searxng-web.intentEn: DeepSeek Harness plugin that backs the native web_search / web_fetch tools with your own self-hosted SearXNG instance — keyless, private, no third-party search vendor; rides dsh's ctx.web provider seam so every agent and subagent inherits it, with an SSRF-guarded fetch provider included.
maxwell-feng/dsh-searxng-web.intentZh: 用自托管的 SearXNG 实例接管 DSH 原生 web_search / web_fetch 工具：无需 API Key、查询不经过第三方搜索厂商；走 dsh 的 ctx.web 提供方接缝，所有 agent 与 subagent 直接继承，另带 SSRF 防护的网页抓取提供方。
